content: TanStack Query works fine for fetching static JSON files (fetch('/data/x.json') as queryFn) and gives caching/loading/error states for free, but is arguably overkill for purely static, rarely-changing data; plain useEffect+fetch or a tiny SWR-style hook is also viable. Value for this project: consistent loading/error UI across 8 pages, background refetch when data updates (weekly export), devtools for debugging.
